appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Reservoir Surface Temperature Trend'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 24.0°C, with labeled tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
The data is represented by a blue line connecting black circular data points.
Each data point is annotated with its exact temperature value in °C.
